labels.name: metric-rfc
labels.description: Metric change proposal; frozen through alpha

issues.title: Freeze M01–M20 registry
issues.body: Encode exactly 20 metrics with evidence, opportunity, gaming guard, treatment, and consumer routes. RED must reject M21, gaps, duplicates, and dead routes.

issues.title: Freeze adapter observability matrix
issues.body: Version every event group's capability status, evidence source, and missing-evidence effect. Silent inference and source-less REQUIRED rows fail.

issues.title: Simulate pack time and opportunity eligibility
issues.body: Preregister and simulate duration, metric eligibility, and prescription eligibility. Freeze only if median ≤40m, p90 ≤45m, eligible metrics ≥14, and at least one authoritative two-opportunity lever path pass together.

issues.title: Freeze deterministic lever registry
issues.body: Implement safety-first eligibility, factor priority, metric selection, cost/permission tie-break, and MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED without generated advice.

issues.title: Define normalized trace schema
issues.body: Define bounded vendor-neutral trace events, identity, correlation, digest, and redaction fields. Hidden reasoning, secrets, and unbounded payloads fail validation.

issues.title: Define result and Opportunity Profile schemas
issues.body: Define evidence status, optional-score rules, factor/safety separation, takeover, provenance, and Opportunity Profile identity. Percentile without calibration must be unrepresentable.

issues.title: Add schema conformance and compatibility gate
issues.body: Provide offline positive/negative conformance, fixture census, semver compatibility verdict, and digest manifest. Zero fixtures and silent breaking changes fail CI.

issues.title: Implement eligibility and metric aggregation
issues.body: Derive denominators from sealed opportunities, enforce authoritative evidence, deduplicate correlation IDs, and keep NOT_OBSERVED distinct from zero.

issues.title: Implement AOS-P0 and factor scoring
issues.body: Implement frozen weights, harmonic mean, zero semantics, factor mapping, stable rounding, and canonical JSON with independent vector cross-checks.

issues.title: Implement safety and evidence issuance gate
issues.body: Order identity/tamper, safety, integrity, coverage, and score gates. S2/S3, stale evidence, low coverage, and missing required identity withhold ordinary score issuance.

issues.title: Build six conformance fixture families
issues.body: Ship deterministic pass, fail, false-completion, stale-evidence, duplicate-run, and unsafe fixtures with unique reasons, canonical outputs, and mutation detection.

issues.title: Implement fresh workspace lifecycle
issues.body: Create explicit-root immutable workspaces with containment, digest, dirty-base, symlink, wrong-target, interruption, and cross-run residue tests.

issues.title: Separate worker, oracle, and secrets
issues.body: Enforce process, environment, descriptor, path, IPC, and redaction boundaries. Oracle or secret access is INVALID/unsafe, never a warning.

issues.title: Enforce budgets, faults, retry, and terminal states
issues.body: Implement seeded faults, atomic budgets, watchdog/process reconciliation, idempotency, and exactly one typed terminal state without silent fallback.

issues.title: Define adapter interface and capability doctor
issues.body: Define runtime lifecycle/event/capability contracts and make doctor enumerate every status, source, effect, and digest; missing REQUIRED evidence exits nonzero.

issues.title: Implement Codex adapter v0
issues.body: Normalize declared observable Codex sources with bounded redaction and explicit unavailable events. Missing exact identity blocks score issuance.

issues.title: Implement Claude Code adapter v0
issues.body: Normalize declared wrapper/hook/derived sources without hidden reasoning, guessed permission, secret leakage, or invented delegation joins.

issues.title: Prove semantic parity across adapters
issues.body: Use shared semantic fixtures and adapter-specific native inputs to prove equivalent normalized traces while preserving meaningful differences.

issues.title: Implement sealed scenario registry
issues.body: Register form/family/version, budgets, opportunities, faults, oracle, exposure, and worker visibility. Late opportunities and hidden-data leakage fail.

issues.title: Build FAM-1 and FAM-2 scenarios
issues.body: Build contracting and context/decoy/injection scenarios with deterministic hidden outcomes, sealed opportunity maps, and no forced solution path.

issues.title: Build FAM-3 and FAM-4 scenarios
issues.body: Build graph/routing/join and loop/state/retry/stall scenarios where multiple valid operating routes remain possible.

issues.title: Build FAM-5 and FAM-6 scenarios
issues.body: Build false-completion/stale-evidence and recovery/safety/efficiency scenarios using simulated effects, no real credentials or external actions.

issues.title: Compose and freeze Form A pack
issues.body: Prove preregistered timing, eligibility, non-duplication, terminal integrity, and prescription thresholds simultaneously before freezing Form A.

issues.title: Render canonical Markdown and JSON reports
issues.body: Render status, provenance, Opportunity Profile, coverage, factors, safety, limitations, and stable bytes without recomputing scores.

issues.title: Add metric-event-artifact drill-down
issues.body: Resolve contained exact-digest evidence chains and fail report issuance on missing, stale, traversing, or mismatched links.

issues.title: Render deterministic diagnosis and one lever
issues.body: Render only the registered selection trace, evidence, cost, application, and retest conditions; otherwise emit manual review.

issues.title: Implement Snapshot ESTIMATE output
issues.body: Provide only estimate band, recommended family, and next command with mandatory watermark; prohibit AOS-P0, safety-clear, percentile, and performed-assessment language.

issues.title: Build linked but non-reused Form B
issues.body: Create a different repository, surface, and traps for the same construct/opportunity profile with exposure-distance and leakage checks.

issues.title: Implement seven-day sprint and exposure ledger
issues.body: Record one treatment, adherence, deviations, costs, immutable baseline, local-only data, and form exposure; repeated form or second treatment invalidates growth.

issues.title: Evaluate transfer signal and growth eligibility
issues.body: Require target improvement, verification non-degradation, safety, cost, exposure, adherence, and linking gates; decompose invalid/negative outcomes honestly.

issues.title: Build README, demos, and contributor entry points
issues.body: Maintain explicit current/planned boundaries, verified commands, fixture-backed examples, safe issue templates, and no promotional generated attribution.
issues.deps: T-103; production claims also require T-601 and T-204

issues.title: Run preregistered 20-person alpha path
issues.body: Freeze scorer/tasks/analysis, balance known groups, counterbalance forms, conserve all rows, report missingness, and evaluate person/task/session variance without post-hoc primary subsets.

issues.title: Publish validation limitations intended use and judge reliability
issues.body: Regenerate all numbers from frozen results, expose negative outcomes/deviations, and prohibit unsupported percentile, certification, hiring, or industry-standard claims.

issues.title: Decide license notices and enforce publication gate
issues.body: Record an explicit license decision, dependency inventory, third-party notices, and one-time owner publication approval. Missing or stale authority fails closed.

issues.title: Obtain external fixture reproduction and first contribution
issues.body: Verify an independent fresh-clone fixture reproduction with exact versions/digests and one accepted technical contribution before G4 completes.
